questions.stem: Brief 301 gives a circle with diameter 18. What is the radius?
questions.explanation: Radius is half the diameter, so 18/2=9. Doubling or equating with diameter gives wrong values.

questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.stem: Brief 302 asks for the definition of a chord. Which description is correct?

options.text: A line through the center perpendicular to a chord.
A segment whose endpoints lie on the circle.
A segment from center to a point on circle.
A line tangent to the circle at one point.

questions.explanation: A chord is a segment with both endpoints on the circle. Radius, tangent, and perpendicular bisector are different objects.
questions.hint: Endpoints on the circle define chord.

questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.stem: Brief 303 shows a central angle of 80 degrees. What is the inscribed angle subtending the same arc?
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc, so 80/2=40. Equating or doubling gives wrong values.
questions.hint: Inscribed angle is half central angle.
